absent_because.max_decompressed_bytes: this adapter inflates nothing: a compressed response is unwrapped by synapse-decode --container gzip under the host's own bounds before the adapter is handed it
absent_because.max_objects: not a bound of its own: one Event per sample and one Entity, and a sample row is at least 26 octets (a 16-character stamp, a value, the flags and the line end), so max_input_bytes bounds the count
absent_because.max_parse_seconds: no wall-clock bound is enforced: this module reads no clock, and every pass over the response is one walk of its lines or its parsed records; the conformance suite's parser worker kills a decode that overruns its deadline

max_depth.enforced_at: for a dict and for JSON octets, the base class: `Adapter.__init_subclass__`'s wrapper calls `adapter.enforce_depth_bound` before this class's `to_cdm` runs, so JSON text past the bound never reaches `json.loads`
max_depth.source: A JSON response nests three containers (the response, data, a record) and the CSV twin three (the twin, rows, a row). 64 (`MAX_DEPTH`, `adapters/coops_csv.py`) is the harness loader's own bound and the figure the JSON-reading adapters of synapse_cdm declare. This is an IMPLEMENTATION CAP and is NOT the format's normative maximum.

max_input_bytes.enforced_at: `Adapter.__init_subclass__` wraps this class's own `to_cdm` with `enforce_input_bound` at class-definition time (`adapter.py`, `_bind_input_bound`), so the octets are measured and refused before this module decodes a line or a JSON token
max_input_bytes.source: The API bounds a request by its time range — 6-minute data one month a request, hourly data one year (research-station-text F05, the API page) — and states no size; a month of 6-minute samples is 7 440 rows and a year of hourly ones 8 784. DECISIONS U-07 rules one station-text file at most 8 MiB (8 388 608 octets, `MAX_INPUT_BYTES`, `adapters/coops_csv.py`), over a kilobyte a row for the longer of the two. This is an IMPLEMENTATION CAP and is NOT the format's normative maximum.

message_types: NOAA CO-OPS datagetter response: the CSV form of water_level, air_pressure or wind, or the JSON form of water_level, one response per call under the caller's CoopsRequest; one ENVIRONMENTAL_OBSERVATION Event per sample carrying point-observation/1, and the station's Entity
capabilities.unknown_fields_basis: the CSV header is compared whole with the product's own, and the JSON response, its metadata and each data record are closed key sets read off the API's response, so a column or a key this module does not know is refused rather than carried

limitations.summary: a response echoes none of the request's datum, units, time zone or interval, and the CSV form not its station: they are the caller's required CoopsRequest, and a JSON response naming another station is refused
time_zone lst_ldt is refused by name (DECISIONS L-11): daylight-saving local time needs a time-zone database; gmt is read as UTC, and lst with the caller's declared standard-time offset

the CSV form of water_level, air_pressure and wind and the JSON form of water_level are read; every other product, and the JSON form of air_pressure and wind, whose record keys the design record does not hold, are refused

the request's units (metric or english) is every value's unit, verbatim under the request parameter's namespace; no unit string is derived from it, and wind's degrees direction is the one value with a unit of its own
a blank field is refused blank-value: the design record does not hold how the API writes a missing sample, so this module neither reads a blank as a sentinel nor drops the reading
wind's second Direction column, the compass point, is text and not a measurement; it stays in each Event's residual row
`evidence.available` is false because no published Release carries this adapter's records yet; it becomes true at the first release that attaches them

maturity.basis: L3 PROVENANCE VERIFIED, from evidence that runs today in this package: `synapse_cdm.harness --adapter coops_csv` over the packaged fixture set reports `translate`, `schema` and `provenance` PASS on every fixture, which carries L1 to L3, and its `lossless` column rests on the path-bound ledger (`MAPPINGS` declared, every row or record a structured residual on its own Event) with no LOST leaf on any parsed form. L4 is NOT declared: this adapter is ingest-only, so the roundtrip check is inapplicable rather than passed (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.6, rule 4), and a rung passed vacuously is not a rung declared.

adapter.name: NOAA CO-OPS data API response (CSV and JSON) translator
